# ArkLink: Global Extremes

> A free offline branching visual novel and fictional climate mystery. Investigate altered evidence and choose between a community’s survival and your son’s medical access. / ArkLink: 全球极端灾变，免费无广告的离线分支视觉小说，在证据、河谷生存与儿子的治疗权限之间抉择。

## Product facts

- Official App Store app ID: 6773223162. The linked release is for iPhone and iPad, requiring iOS or iPadOS 15.1 or later. No Google Play download is listed here.
- English and Simplified Chinese are included. Free to play, with no ads or required game account.
- Play Carter Li, a catastrophe claims actuary, inside a near-future disaster claims terminal. Main chapters, unlockable side-story archives, different endings and recorded routes support chapter replay. No total playtime or fixed ending count is stated.
- The opening T-402 case starts with a 90-second action budget and two override permits. This is not a real-time reading countdown or the length of the game. Reading, opening logs, saving and resuming do not spend it. Charged choices show costs; manual review can extend the window, and an override can freeze automatic denial. These resource rules do not apply to every chapter.
- Progress saves locally. Restarting a chapter preserves discovered files and recorded outcomes; clearing progress deletes the local story record. Cloud sync and cross-device transfer are not promised.
- Public version 1.2.0, checked 2026-11-11, refreshes reading, history and chapter navigation. It includes T-402 mechanics, profile abilities and optional terminal sound effects. Older first-chapter saves keep their original story mode until replayed. Release builds hide developer score-change and route previews, not operation costs.
- The story is fiction, not professional climate, medical, financial or insurance advice.
